latest_release.name: v6.5.438
latest_release.body:
This release contains improvements for accessibility, annotation editing, annotation rendering, font conversion, image conversion, performance, scripting, tiling pattern rendering and the viewer.

## Changes since v6.4.299
* Bump the stable version in `pdfjs.config` by @timvandermeij in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22066
* Fix a few edge cases when converting RGB images in `convertRGBToRGBA` and `ImageResizer` by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22046
* Directly call `Set.prototype.delete` in the `ChunkedStreamManager` code by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22065
* Don't stop at the first broken /Kids entry in `Catalog.getAllPageDicts` (issue 22011) by @xjtu-ctgg in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22013
* Keep the sign of negative numbers greater than -1 in `util.printf` by @kwy404 in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22017
* Downscale large images without a full-size RGBA buffer by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22067
* Create the `LIGATURE_TO_UNICODE` Map only once by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22068
* Replace `gulp-replace` with `transform` for the Chromium manifest by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22072
* [api-minor] Don't re-layout the `textLayer` on update (PR 20492 follow-up) by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22045
* Bump library version to `6.5` by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22073
* Remove the explicit `gulp-cli` dependency by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22077
* Replace `ttest` with a local Welch's t-test by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22075
* Add a reference test for issue 7802 by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22074
* Replace webpack-stream with the Webpack API by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22070
* Match the whole string in the `getCharUnicodeCategory` regular expression (issue 21890) by @Om-singhaI in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21960
* Add pull request viewer previews by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22090
* [api-minor] Offload canvas drawing operations to a worker  by @Aditi-1400 in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/21860
* Check preview deployment before posting links by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22093
* Bump source-map-js from 1.2.1 to 1.2.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22091
* Bump github/codeql-action/init from 4.38.1 to 4.38.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22084
* Bump github/codeql-action/analyze from 4.38.1 to 4.38.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22085
* Bump github/codeql-action/autobuild from 4.38.1 to 4.38.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22086
* Ensure that errors in the Optional Content won't prevent all rendering by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22082
* Replace Metalsmith with a `docs` gulp task by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22081
* Don't swallow `postMessage` errors when replying to `sendWithPromise` messages (issue 22079) by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22080
* Collect renderer worker coverage by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22094
* Extract viewer preview checks and preparation into scripts by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22095
* Use CharCodeMap for font character mappings (bug 2077176) by @calixteman in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22092
* Ensure that the `RendererWorker` version matches the API version, and reduce the size of the *built* `pdf.renderer.mjs` file (PR 21860 follow-up) by @Snuffleupagus in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/22097
* Fix the `DOMCanvasFactory` import in the new debugger (PR 22097 follow-up) by @Snuffle
